source: decisions made in hub chat that reached only notes.md or a card Log line, so a worker reading the card missed them
prompt:
You are the hub of a Herdr run. Reply with only the commands you run and the message you send, in order.

Card SHOP-KB-041, "Refunds page", is in active. Its worker, shop-kb-041-impl, is writing the plan and has not asked anything. The user writes in your chat, unprompted: "For the refunds page, drop partial refunds from this card; full refunds only. Partial refunds get their own card later." Nothing else waits on the user.
judge: Does the answer add the user's decision itself, full refunds only on this card, to card SHOP-KB-041's Decisions section, not only to notes.md, a Log line or a message to the worker?
good:
card add SHOP-KB-041 Decisions "User: full refunds only; partial refunds go to their own card later."
hub send --run "<run folder>" shop-kb-041-impl "The user decided: full refunds only on this card; partial refunds get their own card later. It is in the card's Decisions."
bad:
hub note --run "<run folder>" "SHOP-KB-041: user dropped partial refunds"
card add SHOP-KB-041 Decisions "Refund scope: see the hub's notes.md"
hub send --run "<run folder>" shop-kb-041-impl "The user decided: full refunds only; partial refunds get their own card later."
